$comment: Contract for data/tables/print_guide.csv. Checked by build/src/schema.js; compiled by build/src/print-guide.js (D88).
title: Print guide
description: What a printer maker's filament guide states for printing a material type, one row per type the guide heads a column with, in a print profile's columns, from a retrieved, hash-checked and cited guide. It is no product's profile. Where a product's own profiles, and its twin's (D89), say nothing on a part of its print gate (nozzle, bed, chamber, enclosure, hardened nozzle), the build reads the row of its material (print_guide_materials.csv) and labels it as the guide's, never the maker's (D88). The drying statement is recorded and fills no product's recipe.

fields.name: PrintGuideID
fields.description: Stable identifier (PG###; npm run data:new-id -- print_guide).

fields.name: SourceID
fields.description: The guide: a retrieved source in sources.csv with Citation role cited (PRINT-GUIDE-REFERENCE).

fields.name: Guide type
fields.description: The material type as the guide heads its column (PC, PETG HF, TPU 95A HF). Which of our materials it is, is print_guide_materials.csv.

fields.name: Nozzle °C
fields.description: The guide's nozzle temperature as printed; parsed by the build.

fields.name: Nozzle state
fields.description: Reviewed reading of Nozzle °C, as a profile's.

fields.name: Nozzle min °C
fields.description: Lower end of the window; Not applicable unless the state is range.

fields.name: Nozzle max °C
fields.description: Upper end of the window; Not applicable unless the state is range.

fields.name: Nozzle requirement
fields.description: required, recommended, none or unknown.

fields.name: Bed °C
fields.description: The guide's build plates and bed temperatures as printed, every plate; parsed by the build as one window across them.

fields.name: Bed state
fields.description: Reviewed reading of Bed °C, as a profile's.

fields.name: Bed min °C
fields.description: Lower end of the window; Not applicable unless the state is range.

fields.name: Bed max °C
fields.description: Upper end of the window; Not applicable unless the state is range.

fields.name: Bed requirement
fields.description: required, recommended, none or unknown.

fields.name: Chamber °C
fields.description: The guide's chamber temperature as printed, or Not published where it has no such row. An enclosure it says is not needed clears the chamber, as a profile's does; one it asks for on its maker's own enclosed printers is declared in Chamber state (D90).

fields.name: Chamber state
fields.description: Reviewed reading of Chamber °C, as a profile's; or enclosed, where the row asks for an enclosure on its maker's own enclosed printers and states no temperature: the H2C's heated chamber meets it (D90), and Parse review says so.

fields.name: Chamber min °C
fields.description: Lower end of the window; Not applicable unless the state is range.

fields.name: Chamber max °C
fields.description: Upper end of the window; Not applicable unless the state is range.

fields.name: Chamber requirement
fields.description: required, recommended, none or unknown.

fields.name: Enclosure
fields.description: The guide's answer to printing with an enclosure, as printed; a mark drawn in place of a word is written as its glyph (✓ or ✗). Parsed by the build.

fields.name: Enclosure state
fields.description: Reviewed reading of Enclosure.

fields.name: Drying
fields.description: The guide's drying statement as printed, each row it comes from named. Recorded; it fills no product's recipe (D88).

fields.name: Drying state
fields.description: stated or unknown.

fields.name: Drying °C
fields.description: Drying temperature as the parser reads it.

fields.name: Drying hours
fields.description: Drying time as the parser reads it.

fields.name: Nozzle size / material
fields.description: The nozzle sizes and materials the guide lists, as printed; parsed by the build for whether a hardened nozzle is needed.

fields.name: Hardened nozzle
fields.description: Whether the guide says a hardened nozzle is needed: TRUE where it lists hardened steel alone, FALSE for any nozzle, Not published where it settles neither.

fields.name: Locator
fields.description: The page, the column heading and the row labels each cell was read under.

fields.name: Parse review
fields.description: Why a typed value differs from the parser reading of the raw text, when it does; otherwise Not applicable. A typed value that differs without a review stops the build.
